title: Jack Rabbit Cyber Rabbit Neon Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Jack Rabbit’s Cyber Rabbit Neon nic salt is an exquisite blend of juicy, soft peach on the inhale and a bright and tangy grapefruit on the exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
